# Data classes

What each persisted class can contain and how long it is kept. A retention policy that
does not say what is *in* the thing being retained is a number with no argument behind
it (FR-27.1).

| Class | May contain | Retention | Erasable by subject |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ledger` | `metadata` | until erased | **no** |
| `transcript` | `credentials`, `personal_data`, `repository_content` | 30d | yes |
| `awareness_pack` | `personal_data`, `repository_content` | 30d | yes |
| `evidence` | `credentials`, `repository_content` | 180d | yes |
| `recording` | `personal_data`, `repository_content` | 90d | yes |
| `memory` | `personal_data`, `repository_content` | until erased | yes |
| `spec` | `repository_content` | until erased | **no** |
| `workspace` | `credentials`, `repository_content` | 6h | **no** |
